Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		obs: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.SuspensionDays>0)
	precondition:
		obs.notEmpty() = true
	postcondition:
		obs->forAll(u: User|u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre-1) and
		obs->forAll(u: User|u.SuspensionDays<>0 or
		u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND)
}
